notes.title: Have You Checked Out Our Upcoming VR Game Shooty Fruity?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28734688/2579a4c8a9f36a0f1bbf1075b714e15b19617e80.jpg[/img]

We thought you might like to know about our upcoming multi-tasking shooter for VR – [i]Shooty Fruity[/i]! The game challenges you to scan pack and serve whilst firing high octane weaponry at hordes of mutant fruit.  You can check out the latest trailer for the game [url=https://youtu.be/tuWkPIV7Hw8]here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28734688/7853953f5d9e4406117d9d3394d69693d43e55a6.jpg[/img]

Coming to HTC Vive and Oculus Rift on December 19th, the game has been designed from the ground up for VR and motion controllers, and is jampacked with weapons, enemy fruit and power-ups across the numerous shifts in the game’s ‘career’ mode.  The game also features multiple tasks to do whilst shooting fruit, including checkout and the newly announce canteen.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28734688/c39657d1ea822b1c84bd998db30d9da500ecc874.jpg[/img]

You can find out more information on the Shooty Fruity’s [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/666100/Shooty_Fruity/]store page[/url], the [url=http://ndreams.com/titles/shootyfruity/]website[/url], or via [url=https://www.facebook.com/nDreamsVR/]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/nDreamsVR?ref_src=twsrc%5Egoogle%7Ctwcamp%5Eserp%7Ctwgr%5Eauthor]Twitter[/url]. And if you have any questions get chatting in the game's [url=http://steamcommunity.com//app/666100/]discussion forum[/url] or tweet us at [url=https://twitter.com/nDreamsVR?ref_src=twsrc%5Egoogle%7Ctwcamp%5Eserp%7Ctwgr%5Eauthor]@nDreamsVR[/url] with the hashtag [b]#ShootyFruity[/b].

notes.title: Bloody Zombies is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AMR06kJ.gif[/img]

We are excited to announce that Bloody Zombies is now live worldwide and is available to purchase on Steam! 

Watch the launch trailer here: https://youtu.be/rWxX013ANVc

[h1]What is Bloody Zombies?[/h1]
Bloody Zombies is a co-op brawler designed to be played with any combination of TV/monitor and VR players. Fight across the ruins of London using carefully refined Free-Form Combat, taking down a terrifying variety of undead with an expanding special move-set. Created for 1-4 players, Bloody Zombies is also enhanced with VR - using its unique viewpoint to help the team overcome obstacles & discover secrets in the game.

[h1]Do I Need a VR Headset to play Bloody Zombies?[/h1]
If you don't own a VR headset you can still enjoy Bloody Zombies. You will be able to play with a gamepad or you can use a keyboard! 

[h1]How does the VR work?[/h1]
VR and non-VR players each have full access to all content in the game, and core gameplay is the same.  Enhancements through VR are purely focused on the unique viewpoint allowed by the device, and encourage collaboration between the VR player and others without excluding access to content to non-VR players.

A good example of this is the secrets in the first level of the game.  These are much easier to spot to a VR player, who can look around to find these, however to a team made up of purely non-VR players these secrets would be stumbled upon accidentally, or deciphered through subtle environment hints.

[h1]Read the reviews[/h1]
VR Focus - 80% - https://vrgamecritic.com/game/bloody-zombies 

[h1]Got any questions?[/h1]
You can get in touch with us on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/449640/discussions/0/]forum![/url]

[h1]Need support?[/h1]
Please contact support@ndreams.com if you're having trouble. Replies will be in English. Alternatively, leave a post in our dedicated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/449640/discussions/1/]support sub forum[/url] and one of the team will respond.

Fight across the ruins of London using carefully refined Free-Form Combat, taking down a terrifying variety of mutated zombies with an expanding special move-set. Created for 1-4 players, for online and offline play, Bloody Zombies is also enhanced with HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.

notes.title: Bloody Zombies launches on September 12th
notes.content:
Hey Guys!

The E3 award-winning co-op brawler Bloody Zombies will launch September 12th for £10.99/€13.49/$14.99 on VR headsets.

Bloody Zombies is a one-to-four player co-op brawler designed to be played with any combination of TV and VR players, online or on the couch. Set in a London wasteland, bloody zombies have taken over the city and four rough-and-tough cockney misfits must work together to beat back the rotting hordes. 

Bloody Zombies features easily accessible moves, deep freeform combat, and brutal chainable combos. Players can also unlock special moves and discover melee weapons to expand their zombie-slaying abilities. The enhanced VR viewpoint means VR players can also find in-game secrets, provide tactical support, and conquer obstacles using a unique diorama view.

Got any questions? Start up a conversation in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/449640/discussions]discussion forum.[/url]
